home.title: Storage
home.noAdminBody: Scans use the slower folder walk, and some system folders stay hidden.
home.noDrives: Lustro found no fixed or USB drives.

admin.dialogBody1: Windows shows a User Account Control prompt. Then Lustro restarts with admin rights.
admin.dialogBody2: With admin rights you get the fast scan, live updates, system folders and the system cleaner.
admin.cancelled: Lustro still runs without admin rights. You cancelled the Windows prompt.
admin.failed: Lustro could not restart as administrator: {{error}}
admin.unixHint: To get admin rights, close Lustro and start it as root (for example with sudo).

settings.title: Settings
settings.aboutHint: Free and open source (MIT). Lustro is Latin for “I purify” and “I survey”.
settings.defaultDeleteHint: The Delete key uses this. Shift+Delete always deletes permanently.
settings.askPermanentHint: Always on. You cannot undo a permanent delete.
settings.protectedHint: Windows, the Program Files folders, the page file, drive roots and profile folders. Lustro never deletes them.
settings.allowAppFoldersHint: Only as admin. You can then delete app and game folders inside Program Files, with a warning each time. Windows folders stay protected.
settings.devAgeHint: Lustro selects node_modules, target and similar folders only in projects with no change for this many days.
settings.keepInTrayHint: Closing the window keeps Lustro running in the tray, so it can warn you about low space.
settings.lowSpaceHint: Sends a Windows notification when a drive has less free space than this. Once a day per drive.
settings.startWithWindowsHint: Starts in the tray, without admin rights.
settings.explorerMenuHint: Adds the command to the right-click menu of folders and drives (under “Show more options”).
settings.ignoreHint: Duplicates, clean-up items, your rules, and large and old files skip these folders and everything inside them.
settings.lowSpaceActions: When a drive is low, also run
settings.lowSpaceActionsHint: Once a day for a low drive, Lustro runs what you check here, then tells you what it freed. A rule runs when its folder is on that drive; clean-up items run when the drive holds your home folder. Lustro skips items whose program is open.

scan.deniedNote_one: Windows refused access to 1 folder. Run as admin to include it.
scan.deniedNote_other: Windows refused access to {{count}} folders. Run as admin to include them.
scan.pickBody: Lustro scans the drive and shows what uses the space.
scan.notScannedBody: Scan it to see its folders and files.

explore.hint: Click to select. Double-click to zoom in.
explore.protected: Protected system path. Lustro never deletes it.
explore.appFolder: App folder in Program Files. You can delete it, but you must confirm a warning.
explore.appFolderLocked: App folder in Program Files. To delete it, run as admin and turn on Settings > Allow deleting app folders.
explore.link: This is a link to another folder. Lustro does not count its target.
explore.onlineOnly: Online-only file. It uses no space on this PC.
explore.denied: Windows lets only admins read this folder.
explore.selectHint: Select a folder or a file.
explore.scanRoot: This is the scanned folder. Open it to delete items inside.

files.title: Large and old files
files.largestHint: The biggest files on all scanned drives.
files.oldestHint: Files that nobody changed for more than 1 year.
files.name: Name
files.noScans: Scan a drive first. Then this list shows its biggest and oldest files.
files.binNote: Files in the Recycle Bin still use space. Empty the bin, or use Shift+Delete to delete permanently.

del.recycleNote: You can restore it from History or from the Recycle Bin.
del.permanentWarn: You cannot undo this. The item does not go to the Recycle Bin.
del.doneRecycled_one: Moved 1 item to the Recycle Bin ({{size}}).
del.doneRecycled_other: Moved {{n}} items to the Recycle Bin ({{size}}).
del.recycleTitleMany: Move {{n}} items to the Recycle Bin?
del.partial: Deleted {{ok}} of {{total}} items. The first problem: {{reason}}
del.appWarn_one: This item is inside Program Files. The app or game can stop working, and Windows can still list it as installed. If you can, use Installed apps > Uninstall instead.
del.appWarn_other: {{count}} items are inside Program Files. These apps or games can stop working, and Windows can still list them as installed. If you can, use Installed apps > Uninstall instead.

history.title: History
history.summary: {{size}} freed. Lustro keeps this log on this PC only.
history.empty: Nothing deleted yet. Deleted items show here.
history.gone: No longer in the Recycle Bin

clean.title: Clean up
clean.measuringHint: Lustro looks at temp folders, caches and logs. Nothing is deleted yet.
clean.groupHint: Safe items are selected. Items that need a choice are not.
clean.permanentNote: Cleaner items are deleted permanently. They are caches and temp files that apps make again.
clean.confirmBody: These items are deleted permanently. Apps make these caches again when they need them.
clean.doneSkipped: Cleaned {{size}}. {{n}} files were in use and stayed.

custom.title: Your rules
custom.rowHint: Old build folders, by your own rules
custom.hint: In a folder that you choose, Lustro finds folders with the names that you type (for example node_modules), or files that match a pattern (for example *.iso). It moves them to the Recycle Bin when they had no change for the number of days.
custom.emptyBody: Add a rule, for example: in your projects folder, remove node_modules from projects that nobody changed for 30 days.
custom.folderHint: Lustro looks in this folder and in all folders inside it.
custom.pickFolder: Choose the folder with your projects
custom.targetsHint: Separate the names with commas, for example: node_modules, target, .venv
custom.ageHint: A project is untouched when no file in it changed for this time. The named folders do not count.
custom.scheduleHint: Lustro runs the rule by itself, also from the tray, and sends a notification.
custom.name: Rule name
custom.ageUnknown: the project has no other files, so it is not selected
custom.noMatches: There is no folder with these names in this folder.
custom.runBody_one: Lustro moves the folders named {{names}} to the Recycle Bin when their project had no change for 1 day. You can restore them from History.
custom.runBody_other: Lustro moves the folders named {{names}} to the Recycle Bin when their project had no change for {{count}} days. You can restore them from History.
custom.noneDue: No project is untouched for long enough. Nothing moved.
custom.done_one: Moved 1 folder to the Recycle Bin ({{size}}).
custom.done_other: Moved {{count}} folders to the Recycle Bin ({{size}}).
custom.doneErrors_one: Moved 1 folder ({{size}}). {{errors}} could not move: History shows why.
custom.doneErrors_other: Moved {{count}} folders ({{size}}). {{errors}} could not move: History shows why.
custom.deleteBody: Only the rule goes. Lustro deletes no folder now.
custom.patternsHint: Separate the patterns with commas. * stands for any text, ? for one character, for example: *.iso, Screen Recording*.mov
custom.ageHintFiles: A file is selected when it had no change for this time.

dupes.title: Duplicates
dupes.intro: Lustro compares files in your scans by size, then by content (BLAKE3 hash). Hard links and online-only OneDrive files are skipped.
dupes.noScans: Scan a drive or folder first. Then Lustro looks for duplicates in it.
dupes.none: No duplicates found. Every file of this size is unique.
dupes.keepOne: Keep at least one copy. Lustro does not delete every copy of a file.
dupes.note: Files with the same size and the same content hash are duplicates. The copies go to the Recycle Bin, so you can restore them.
dupes.includeAppData: Include app data folders (AppData, ProgramData). Lustro does not select copies there for you.
dupes.autoNote: Lustro selects extra copies only of photos, videos, music, documents and archives outside program and tool folders. Choose the other groups yourself.
dupes.nameIntro: Same name finds files with the same name in different folders, also copy names like “photo (1).jpg” or “report - Copy.docx”. The content can differ, so Lustro selects nothing for you.
dupes.nameFiles: {{n}} files with this name · up to {{size}}
dupes.noneName: No files with the same name found.
dupes.pickKeep: Keep the copies in this folder
dupes.keepThisFolder: Keep the copies in this folder, in all groups
dupes.keptIn_one: Kept the copies in {{folder}} in 1 group.
dupes.keptIn_other: Kept the copies in {{folder}} in {{count}} groups.
dupes.pairTitle: Two folders with the same files
dupes.pairNote: Lustro selects the shared copies in that folder and keeps the ones in the other folder. Then use the button on the right to move them to the Recycle Bin.
dupes.folderCopies: {{n}} copies of a folder · {{size}} · {{files}} files each
dupes.folderNote: These folders have the same files, names and subfolders. Delete a whole copy at once. Their files are not in the file groups.
dupes.similarIntro: Similar photos finds the same photo resized, re-saved or in another format (JPEG, PNG, GIF, BMP, WebP, TIFF). HEIC and RAW files are not compared. The photos are not identical, so Lustro selects nothing for you.
dupes.linkBody: Each copy becomes a hard link to the copy that stays: the path stays, but the data is stored once. Only exact copies on the same disk can be linked.
dupes.linkBodyMac: Each copy becomes a clone of the copy that stays: the path stays, and the files share their data until one of them changes. Only exact copies on the same APFS disk can be linked.
dupes.linkSafe: Lustro checks again that each pair has the same content before it links them. History lists every link.
dupes.linkWarn: With hard links, all paths show one file. A change through one path changes all of them. You cannot undo this from History.
dupes.linkErrors_one: Linked 1 copy. {{errors}} could not be linked: {{why}}
dupes.linkErrors_other: Linked {{count}} copies. {{errors}} could not be linked: {{why}}

apps.title: Installed apps
apps.name: Name
apps.uninstallDesktop: Lustro starts the uninstaller of {{publisher}}. Follow its steps to finish.
apps.note: Lustro runs the app's own uninstaller. The uninstaller can ask for admin rights.
apps.lastUsedNote: Last used comes from Windows Prefetch and needs admin rights.
apps.sizeFolder: From the scan of its folder

search.title: Search files
search.hint: Searches the last scan of every drive and folder. Use * and ? as wildcards, for example *.iso.
search.info: {{shown}} of {{total}} results · {{searched}} names searched in {{ms}} ms
search.noScans: Scan a drive or folder first. Then you can search it here.
search.name: Name

live.stale: The change journal of {{root}} was reset. Lustro scans it again.

update.noNotes: This version has fixes and improvements.
update.restartNote: Lustro downloads the update, installs it and starts again.
update.autoHint: From GitHub Releases, when Lustro starts.
